QuestInfo.0: In search of someone to collect #t4009372# to be used as medicine.

yes.0: You're being asked to collect #i4009372:##t4009372# for 'medicinal' purposes, but I've never heard of it being used in medicine. Still, a job's a job. \r\nYou can get the poison by hunting #o9600317# at #m701103030#. This job's a dangerous one, so stay sharp!\r\n

no.0: But who else could I turn to for a quest as difficult as this one? Now, I'm sad.

0.msg: You're amazing! Simply stellar! You're like a deity! You definitely deserve that hero title!

yes.0: Here, take your reward. I wish I could give you more. You're just awesome! I can't wait to work with you again!
